page.title: Listings
page.description: Offers this Hub lists on relays so people without a link can find them
page.emptyHint: List a circle below. A Cash Hub connection is never listed.

health.closing: Closed, kept until its last version expires
health.operatorNotNamed: not yet named by the operator
health.failing: no relay accepted the last version, retrying

dialog.title: List this offer
dialog.description: The listing advertises; the terms always come from the offer itself when someone taps it.

warnings.public: Listing makes this offer public and lets anyone find this node.
warnings.pow: Proof of work on the inbox is off while no proof-of-work relays are set; anyone can send requests.
warnings.circleTerms: For a circle, its access policy and how much it can still take in become readable by anyone.
warnings.followSet: This circle's follow set is public. Consider hidden entries for members who should not be named. The listing's title is not taken from the set.
warnings.operator: Naming an operator publicly links their account to this node.

form.title: Title
form.followSetConfirm: I understand the follow set is public

problems.title: The title must be one line of at most 40 characters.
problems.content: The description must be at most 280 characters.
problems.image: The image must be an https URL.
problems.location: The place must be one line of at most 40 characters, with no link.
problems.regions: Regions are geohash prefixes of 3 or 4 characters.
problems.operator: The operator must be an npub or a 64-character hex pubkey.
problems.operatorRelay: The operator's relay must be a websocket URL.

errors.relays: Could not save the listing relays

address.label: Listing address
address.hint: The operator names this offer from their own Nostr client or with cashctl; this app never asks for their key.

relays.title: Listing relays
relays.description: Listings and this node's relay list go to: {{relays}}. Leave empty for the general relays.

regenerate.button: Revoke and reissue the Cash Hub connection
regenerate.title: Revoke this Cash Hub connection?
regenerate.description: Do this if the connection string was ever published. The old string stops working at once and a new one is shown once. Bills and records are untouched; reconnect your minting client with the new string.
